questions: Do all cars move at the same speed, or could each car have its own 'usual speed'?
Are the cars initially positioned such that each left-to-right car is paired with a right-to-left car at the same starting point, or are they interleaved along the road?
Is a 'collision' counted only once per pair of cars, or each time they cross paths if they could meet multiple times?
Should the function count collisions between cars moving in the same direction (e.g., rear-end) or only opposite directions?
Are the cars considered point objects, or do they have length that could cause multiple collisions if they overlap over time?
Does 'very far from each other' mean the left-to-right cars are all to the left of all right-to-left cars initially?
Is the output the total number of collision events over all time, or until all cars have passed each other?
If two cars collide exactly at the same point and time as a third car, does that count as one collision or multiple?
